params.name: search
params.description: String to search. If the user can make a remote URI search, and the string is an URI then the PeerTube instance will fetch the remote object and add it to its database. Then, you can use the REST API to fetch the complete video information and interact with it.

params.name: uuids
params.description: Find elements with specific UUIDs

params.name: searchTarget
params.description:
If the administrator enabled search index support, you can override the default search target.

**Warning**: If you choose to make an index search, PeerTube will get results from a third party service. It means the instance may not yet know the objects you fetched. If you want to load video/channel information:
  * If the current user has the ability to make a remote URI search (this information is available in the config endpoint),
  then reuse the search API to make a search using the object URI so PeerTube instance fetches the remote object and fill its database.
  After that, you can use the classic REST API endpoints to fetch the complete object or interact with it
  * If the current user doesn't have the ability to make a remote URI search, then redirect the user on the origin instance or fetch
  the data from the origin instance API

params.name: start
params.description: Offset used to paginate results

params.name: count
params.description: Number of items to return

params.name: skipCount
params.description: if you don't need the `total` in the response

params.name: nsfw
params.description: whether to include nsfw videos, if any

params.name: isLive
params.description: whether or not the video is a live

params.name: includeScheduledLive
params.description: whether or not include live that are scheduled for later

params.name: categoryOneOf
params.description: category id of the video (see [/videos/categories](#operation/getCategories))

params.name: licenceOneOf
params.description: licence id of the video (see [/videos/licences](#operation/getLicences))

params.name: languageOneOf
params.description: language id of the video (see [/videos/languages](#operation/getLanguages)). Use `_unknown` to filter on videos that don't have a video language

params.name: tagsOneOf
params.description: tag(s) of the video

params.name: tagsAllOf
params.description: tag(s) of the video, where all should be present in the video

params.name: isLocal
params.description: **PeerTube >= 4.0** Display only local or remote objects

params.name: include
params.description:
**Only administrators and moderators can use this parameter**

Include additional videos in results (can be combined using bitwise or operator)
- `0` NONE
- `1` NOT_PUBLISHED_STATE
- `2` BLACKLISTED
- `4` BLOCKED_OWNER
- `8` FILES
- `16` CAPTIONS
- `32` VIDEO SOURCE

params.name: hasHLSFiles
params.description: **PeerTube >= 4.0** Display only videos that have HLS files

params.name: hasWebVideoFiles
params.description: **PeerTube >= 6.0** Display only videos that have Web Video files

params.name: host
params.description: Find elements owned by this host

params.name: autoTagOneOf
params.description: **PeerTube >= 6.2** **Admins and moderators only** filter on videos that contain one of these automatic tags

params.name: stateOneOf
params.description: **PeerTube >= 8.2** **Admins and moderators only** filter on videos that have one of these states

params.name: privacyOneOf
params.description: **PeerTube >= 4.0** Display only videos in this specific privacy/privacies

params.name: excludeAlreadyWatched
params.description: Whether or not to exclude videos that are in the user's video history

params.name: startDate
params.description: Get videos that are published after this date

params.name: endDate
params.description: Get videos that are published before this date

params.name: originallyPublishedStartDate
params.description: Get videos that are originally published after this date

params.name: originallyPublishedEndDate
params.description: Get videos that are originally published before this date

params.name: durationMin
params.description: Get videos that have this minimum duration

params.name: durationMax
params.description: Get videos that have this maximum duration
